pages.text: Hold a one-handed weapon in your off hand and $(k:use) to attack with it. The off hand has its own cooldown, based on that weapon's speed, so you can alternate hands for a quicker rhythm.$(br2)Off-hand hits deal 85% of the weapon's damage, can crit, and build pressure like any other hit.
You can't attack with the off hand while holding a $(l)two-handed$() weapon in your main hand, and shields stay shields.$(br2)A Glare Strike can be thrown with whichever hand is ready.
